fieldNotes.truckGate: Guarded gate up the private entrance drive: a peaked-roof guard booth sits in the drive median (z20), with split inbound/outbound lanes, barrier-arm gate hardware, and two vehicles queued at capture. Well set back from the public road behind a field/retention-pond buffer.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Peaked/diamond-roof booth in the entrance median - classic staffed truck-gate booth.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Paved turnaround/staging bulb at the gate approach where trucks can wait before the guard.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved yard inside the gate serving the plant, warehouses and trailer rows.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long approach drive from gate to the docks/warehouses (~300m+), holds a deep queue.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimate - multiple dock banks across the plant plus 2-3 long distribution warehouses; heavy outbound can shipping. 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large outbound trailer drop yards east of the warehouses, rows of trailers - 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock clusters: plant docks (west face) vs the distribution-warehouse docks (facing the east trailer yards).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: manufacturing plant + multiple long distribution warehouses + trailer yards on the same Ball property.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur observed running into the property (the long buildings are cross-dock warehouses, truck-served).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Eastern edge of Findlay in an industrial park; farmland immediately adjacent (Rural per rubric).
fieldNotes.identity: Confirmed Ball via the iconic red-white-blue Ball water tower on site (2025-03 Street View).
